• Just now

Yes - we ship internationally to many countries (you can see the full list and options by selecting your region on our Delivery Information page).
For customs and duties: these are set by your local customs authority and can vary by country, and they’re not controlled or charged by us. Any extra fees must be paid by the person receiving the parcel, and we can’t pre-pay, waive, or intervene in customs charges.
One exception: for delivery to the Netherlands, there are no customs and import charges because orders are shipped from within the EU.

What's your return and refund policy?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
You’ve got 30 days from delivery to return items for a refund, as long as they’re unworn, unused, unwashed, and in the same condition you received them (and purchased from our website or app).
A few key exceptions: underwear and swimwear can’t be returned, socks must be sealed, bottles are non-returnable, personalised items can’t be returned, and in the US and Canada items marked “Final Sale” (60%+ off) aren’t returnable.
Refunds go back to the original payment method, and once processed can take up to 7 working days to show in your account.
For France, returns are free, and you can start a return in the returns portal using your order number plus your postcode or email.
